## Why Choose Us
Global Impact  Career Growth  Work Culture
![2026 05 13 Website Career page Link Global Impact R3b](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/2026-05-13-Website-Career-page-Link-Global-Impact-R3b-1024x683.png)
###  Global Impact, Sustainable Future
Be part of a company that plays a key role in the global oleochemical industry, delivering sustainable solutions that are used in everyday products worldwide. Your work contributes to responsible innovation and a greener future.

###  Growth & Development Opportunities
We invest in our people through continuous learning, training programs, and career advancement opportunities—helping you build a long-term, rewarding career.

###  Collaborative & Inclusive Culture
Work in a diverse, supportive environment where teamwork, respect, and open communication empower you to thrive and make meaningful contributions.
## Life at KLK OLEO
At KLK OLEO, we don’t just manufacture products, we create the building blocks for a more sustainable world. Join a global team of innovators dedicated to excellence in oleochemicals and making a tangible difference in the industries we serve.

### Meaningful Work
At KLK OLEO, meaningful work means creating real impact, from sustainable living to green chemistry and global supply chain.

### People First
We value our people, nurturing talent, diversity, and an inclusive workplace culture.

### Discover your potential with KLK OLEO
KLK OLEO’s footprint are in 9 different countries across the world with a workforce surpassing 3,000 employees globally. As we continue to expand our business, we believe that employees are of paramount importance to our long-term business sustainability and growth; thus, we continuously seek talents to join our existing workforce. A career with KLK OLEO means you will be part of something genuinely special. Embracing the Company’s Vision and Values, employees fulfil our Mission to improve more lives and deliver stronger, more effective business results. Through our employee development and competencies framework, we believe in equipping employees with the right tools for their growth and to support the business continuity plan. We are looking for talents with passion, energy, enthusiasm; and more importantly, aligned to our Core Values of _**T** eamwork, **H** umility, **R** esults, **I** ntegrity, **I** nnovation and **L** oyalty._ Join us, be part of our team, and we will unlock your full potential.
